caption: The drawing depicts two small sculptural objects, both shaped like crouching felines, possibly tigers. Each feline is shown in a different perspective, with the one on the left viewed more from the side and the one on the right viewed from a slightly higher angle, showing more of its back. The figures are rendered in shades of dark green, teal, and brown, giving them a metallic, patinated appearance. Both animals are positioned with their heads turned slightly downward and forward, with their front paws clutching a rounded object. Their bodies are elongated, with prominent spines and arched backs, while their tails curve alongside their bodies. The background is plain and light, bringing focus to the two feline objects without any additional elements or distractions.
title: Cat and Ball Coin Bank
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
